name: 1-lauroyl-sn-glycero-3-ph… to D-glucopyranose
summary: A 6-step route from 1-lauroyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine to D-glucopyranose, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: ceramide cholinephosphotransferase
reactions.equation: CDP-choline + an N-acylsphing-4-enine = a sphingomyelin + CMP + H(+)

reactions.name: sphingomyelin phosphodiesterase
reactions.equation: a sphingomyelin + H2O = phosphocholine + an N-acylsphing-4-enine + H(+)

reactions.name: ceramide glucosyltransferase
reactions.equation: an N-acylsphing-4-enine + UDP-alpha-D-glucose = a beta-D-glucosyl-(1<->1')-N-acylsphing-4-enine + UDP + H(+)

reactions.name: ceramide kinase
reactions.equation: an N-acylsphing-4-enine + ATP = an N-acylsphing-4-enine 1-phosphate + ADP + H(+)

reactions.name: sphingolipid 8-(E)-desaturase

reactions.equation: an N-acylsphinganine + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + O2 + 2 H(+) = an N-acylsphing-4-enine + 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + 2 H2O

reactions.name: a ganglioside GT1balpha + CMP-N-acetyl-beta-neuraminate = a ganglioside GQ1b alpha + CM...
reactions.equation: a ganglioside GT1balpha + CMP-N-acetyl-beta-neuraminate = a ganglioside GQ1b alpha + CMP + H(+)
